characters.summary: Lucy van Pelt is a cantankerous and bossy human child who relies primarily on psychological intimidation, verbal harassment, and physical shoves rather than supernatural powers.
weaknesses: easily agitated
susceptible to dog kisses from Snoopy
limitations: limited to human physical strength and capabilities

sources.supports: Character traits, behavior, and typical interactions in Peanuts.

feats.claim: Consistently pulls the football away just as Charlie Brown attempts to kick it, causing him to fall on his back.
Operates a psychiatric booth for five cents, offering dubious psychological advice.

notableResults.note: Tricks Charlie Brown into missing the football every time.

unknowns: Exact adult capabilities are never shown since the strip focuses entirely on childhood.

characters.continuity: Beauty and the Beast (Disney Animated Film)
characters.summary: Lumière is an enchanted candelabra who can use his lit candles to ignite flammable objects and wields hot wax as a deterrent.
weaknesses: vulnerable to being doused with water or extinguished
curse ties his life force to inanimate household objects
limitations: cannot move independently if separated from his assigned form for too long

sources.supports: Abilities, animated film appearance, and curse properties.

feats.claim: Uses his lit candle hands to set things ablaze and defend against intruders in the castle.

notableResults.note: Participates in the castle defense using household hazards.

campaignTags.claim: Has lit candles for hands that burn and ignite objects

unknowns: Full durability against heavy military ordinance is untested.

characters.summary: Maleficent is a powerful dark fairy who combines potent spellcasting, green magical energy projection, and shape-shifting into a giant dragon.
weaknesses: vulnerable to enchanted weapons like the Sword of Truth
hubris and arrogance
limitations: requires her staff or direct gestures for many major magical workings

sources.supports: Magic powers, dragon transformation, and feats from Sleeping Beauty.

feats.claim: Casts a death curse on infant Princess Aurora triggered by a spinning wheel prick before the sun sets on her sixteenth birthday.
Transforms into a colossal fire-breathing dragon during the final battle.

notableResults.note: Defeated when Prince Phillip hurls the Sword of Truth into her chest while in dragon form.

conditional.ability: Dragon form combat and fire breathing

campaignTags.claim: Wields powerful dark fairy magic and curses
Casts complex curses and elemental spells
Possesses large dark wings enabling flight
Teleports in a burst of green flame
Breathes magical green fire in dragon form

unknowns: Full extent of her magic outside of curses and combat transformations is not fully cataloged.

characters.summary: Marge Simpson is an ordinary human homemaker who fights primarily with domestic objects, household tools, or driven persistence when pushed.
weaknesses: human physical limits
moral hesitation
limitations: subject to normal human physical fatigue and injury

sources.supports: General character background and capabilities in The Simpsons.

feats.claim: Subdues unruly individuals and intruders using heavy household items like rolling pins and broomsticks.

notableResults.note: Overcomes social disputes and occasional physical threats through sheer stubbornness.

campaignTags.claim: Pilots automobiles and various other vehicles

unknowns: Combat effectiveness against armed supernatural entities is negligible.

characters.summary: Marvin the Martian is an extraterrestrial commander equipped with advanced alien technology, ray guns, and planet-destroying explosives.

techniques: Illudium Pew-36 Explosive Space Modulator deployment

mechanisms: protective Martian helmet and combat skirt

weaknesses: often thwarted by slapstick setbacks and own faulty equipment
obscured vision through helmet eye slit
limitations: plans routinely thwarted by cartoon physics and Bugs Bunny

sources.supports: Extraterrestrial weapons, flying saucer, and cartoon feats.

feats.claim: Attempts to blow up the Earth using the Illudium Pew-36 Explosive Space Modulator.
Disintegrates obstacles and enemies instantly with his handheld ray pistol.

notableResults.note: Bugs Bunny repeatedly foils his planetary destruction plans.

campaignTags.claim: Uses advanced Martian ray guns and disintegration technology
Pilots a Martian flying saucer spacecraft

unknowns: Exact durability of his helmet against heavy artillery outside of gag physics.

characters.summary: Master Shifu is a red panda kung fu grandmaster who utilizes exceptional martial arts mastery, pressure point strikes, and agile acrobatics.
weaknesses: emotional baggage regarding past students like Tai Lung
small stature against giant opponents
limitations: physical strength limited by small red panda frame

sources.supports: Kung fu mastery, teaching background, and combat skills in Kung Fu Panda.

feats.claim: Trains the Furious Five and Po in advanced kung fu disciplines.
Executes precision nerve strike attacks to immobilize opponents instantly.

notableResults.note: Overpowered by Tai Lung in single combat due to emotional hesitation.

campaignTags.claim: Performs superhuman leaps and aerial martial arts maneuvers

unknowns: Full capability against large-scale magical threats without martial arts application.

characters.continuity: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles (1987 / IDW / General)
characters.summary: Master Splinter is a mutated rat master of ninjutsu who combines stealth, weapon mastery, and martial arts expertise.
weaknesses: aging body vulnerable to severe physical trauma
protective blind spots regarding his adopted turtle sons
limitations: human-sized rat physiology subject to physical limits

sources.supports: Origin as a mutated rat, ninjutsu master, and combat feats.

feats.claim: Trains four mutant turtles in advanced ninjutsu to defeat Shredder.
Defeats multiple Foot Clan ninja simultaneously in close-quarters combat.

notableResults.note: Uses tactical awareness to outmaneuver Shredder on a rooftop.

campaignTags.claim: Master of ninjutsu stealth and silent movement

unknowns: Exact limits against high-tier metahumans with energy projection.

characters.summary: Maui is a shape-shifting demigod of the wind and sea who wields a magical fishhook to alter his form and perform legendary feats of strength.
weaknesses: power is heavily reliant on possessing his magical fishhook
arrogance
limitations: powerless or severely restricted in shapeshifting if disarmed of his fishhook

sources.supports: Demigod powers, shape-shifting, and magical fishhook abilities.

feats.claim: Pulled islands from the sea and lassoed the sun.
Transforms into a giant hawk, shark, or whale at will using his fishhook.

notableResults.note: Fishhook is damaged during initial clash with the lava monster, forcing a retreat.

campaignTags.claim: Wields demigod magic tied to his magical fishhook
Transforms into a hawk to fly across vast distances
Shapeshifts into various animals and large monsters
Expert swimmer and master of the ocean currents

unknowns: Limits of his durability against cosmic-level energy attacks.

characters.summary: Megatron is the ruthless leader of the Decepticons who transforms into a particle beam cannon and wields devastating fusion cannon firepower.
weaknesses: arrogance and overconfidence
betrayal-prone subordinates like Starscream
limitations: requires energon fuel to maintain operations

sources.supports: Decepticon leadership, fusion cannon, and transformation capabilities.

feats.claim: Fires devastating energy blasts from his arm-mounted fusion cannon capable of leveling buildings.
Engages Optimus Prime in mortal combat for leadership of Cybertron.

notableResults.note: Fatally wounded in brutal duel with Optimus Prime before being reformatted into Galvatron.

campaignTags.claim: Cybertronian robotic physiology and advanced weaponry
Flies through space and air in robot/alt modes

unknowns: Exact power scaling varies between cartoon episodes and comic adaptations.

characters.summary: Galvatron is the upgraded, reborn form of Megatron created by Unicron, possessing vastly superior plasma firepower and unhinged cruelty.
weaknesses: mental instability and psychosis induced by Unicron's reformatting
rebellious inner personality that sometimes fights its programming
characters.formDifferences: Replaces Megatron's standard body and fusion cannon with Unicron-upgraded armor, transforming into a futuristic laser cannon/artillery piece instead of a handgun, with significantly increased destructive output and erratic mental stability.

sources.supports: Rebirth from Megatron by Unicron and enhanced destructive capabilities.

unknowns: Full extent of Unicron's direct mental control over him after the creator's destruction.
